class_name: 願望-働きかけ-ホウガヨイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: A conditional clause plus よい: 'if you do X, that's good' — gentle, open-ended advice with no comparison behind it, unlike 〜ほうがいい, which implies the rejected alternative. と, ば, and たら all appear; たらいい and ばいい dominate casual speech, while といい often shades into a bare wish about something outside anyone's control ('I hope it clears up'). Past-tense よかった on this frame (〜ばよかった／〜たらよかった) turns it into regret — what you should have done — not advice; the relief sense you may have seen belongs to the separate 〜てよかった frame.

examples.ruby: 味[あじ]が薄[うす]いと感[かん]じたら、醤油[しょうゆ]を少[すこ]し垂[た]らすといい。
examples.english: If it tastes bland to you, a few drops of soy sauce will do the trick.

examples.ruby: 道[みち]が分[わ]からなければ、駅前[えきまえ]の交番[こうばん]で聞[き]けばいい。
examples.english: If you can't find your way, just ask at the police box by the station.

examples.ruby: 風[かぜ]が強[つよ]いから、上着[うわぎ]を一枚[いちまい]羽織[はお]るといい。
examples.english: It's windy out, so you'd do well to throw a jacket on.

patterns.usage_note: Literally 'the … side is good', so a comparison is always implied: this option over the one being passed up. Advice given about a concrete, present decision typically takes the た-form (行ったほうがいい), which sounds more pointed than the dictionary form; the negative counterpart is 〜ないほうがいい. Because it weighs alternatives it is stronger than 〜といい but far less imperious than 〜がよい.

examples.ruby: 大[おお]きな買[か]い物[もの]だから、一晩[ひとばん]考[かんが]えたほうがいい。
examples.english: It's a big purchase, so you're better off sleeping on it.

examples.ruby: 熱[ねつ]が下[さ]がらないうちは、医者[いしゃ]に行[い]ったほうがいい。
examples.english: As long as the fever isn't coming down, you'd better see a doctor.

examples.ruby: 日帰[ひがえ]りの登山[とざん]なら、荷物[にもつ]は軽[かる]いほうがいい。
examples.english: For a day hike, the lighter your pack the better.

patterns.usage_note: Dictionary form + がよい, an archaic-flavored directive spoken downward: lords, elders, sages and villains in period drama and fantasy. The がいい realization is the ordinary modern one and often carries a dismissive-permissive tone ('好きにするがいい' — suit yourself), while がよい keeps the dignified ring. Unlike 〜ほうがいい it weighs no alternative; it simply tells the listener to proceed.

examples.ruby: 用[よう]が済[す]んだら、速[すみ]やかに立[た]ち去[さ]るがよい。
examples.english: Once your business is done, take your leave at once.

examples.ruby: 申[もう]したいことがあるなら、遠慮[えんりょ]せずに述[の]べるがよい。
examples.english: If you have something to say, say it without holding back.

examples.ruby: 疲[つか]れておるだろう、今宵[こよい]はここで休[やす]むがよい。
examples.english: You must be weary. Rest here for tonight.
